# Dashboard Service

## Purpose
The Dashboard Service manages the configuration and layout of user dashboards. It allows for the creation of customized views, where different widgets and data visualizations (gadgets) can be organized and persisted for specific users or roles.

## Endpoints

| Controller | Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DashboardPreset** | `/plugins/DashboardPreset/getAllDashboardPresets` | POST | Lists all saved dashboards. |
| **GridLayout** | `/plugins/GridLayout/getAllGridLayouts` | POST | Lists grid layout configurations. |
| **CellContent** | `/plugins/CellContent/getAllCellContents` | POST | Lists widget/content definitions. |
| **DataMapper** | `/plugins/DataMapper/getAllDataMappers` | POST | Lists data source mappings. |

## Dependencies
- **dashboard-model**: Core data structures.
- **flexicore-boot**: Plugin system.

## Interesting Features
- **Dynamic Layouts**: Users can define N-column/M-row grids via `GridLayout`.
- **Abstract Data Mapping**: The `DataMapper` allows decoupling visual widgets from their data sources.

## Operation Flow
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Controller as DashboardPresetController
    participant Service as DashboardService

    User->>Controller: createDashboardPreset(DashboardPresetCreate)
    Controller->>Service: createDashboardPreset(DashboardPresetCreate)
    Service-->>User: Preset Created with Layout
```
